unlisted_practices: Embed readability standards, explicit neutrality, and clear visual aids in AI-generated plain language summaries from the outset.
Use standardized templates such as the international SIP template to structure and guide AI-generated summary outputs.
Include diverse training datasets, equity requirements in governance, and low-cost accessible tools to prevent generative AI from widening participation gaps.
Include diverse linguistic data and robust multilingual frameworks so underrepresented language populations are not excluded from AI-generated patient-facing summaries.
Adopt a tiered transparency model that discloses metadata about training sources and performance benchmarks without releasing raw proprietary or patient-level data.
Harmonize core international principles for presenting benefits, risks, and uncertainties in plain-language summaries while allowing cultural and linguistic adaptation.
Develop public-private partnerships and co-developed or open-source AI tools under joint oversight to ensure accessibility for patient groups with varying capacity.

screen.reason: This is a perspective/commentary article discussing the potential, governance, and responsible integration of generative AI to create plain language summaries and support patient involvement in health technology assessment.
